website.readmeExcerpt:
# MouseLock
[![Download count](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://qzysathwfhebdai6xgauhz4q7m0mzmrf.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/MouseLock)](https://github.com/Zeffuro/MouseLock)

MouseLock keeps FFXIV in mouselook until you actually need the cursor. It pauses for chat, bags, menus, and other UI, and can also turn LMB/RMB into configurable game inputs, hotbar actions, or MouseLock controls.

raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
# 1.0.0.3
- Added a true toggle option for tap release, so the cursor can stay free until you tap the modifier again.
- The existing “release until world click or next tap” behavior is still available and remains the default.
- Made tap release safer around Alt+Tab and other modifier combinations.
- Clarified several settings descriptions, especially tap release, resume behavior, and LMB + RMB movement.
